description: Angular component class for configuring attribute settings within a rule node in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and configuration processing.

classes.name: AttributesConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing attribute configuration in rule nodes, extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for attribute configuration.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Specifies form fields that trigger validation.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares the input configuration form based on existing config.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares the output configuration from form data.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form validators based on current form state.
